Symptom: vortex/supplier-quality-deviation-critical (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/vortex/supplier-quality-deviation-critical.yaml): classifying severity critical puts the instance in ERROR SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND. ORCH findings to VERIFY by reading code: fixture test/fixtures/qa/vortex_supplier_quality_deviation_process_definition.json (v1.1) node corrective-action-subprocess (SUB_PROCESS) has no attributes; lib/letflow/engine/sub_process.ex resolve_child_definition/2 reads node.attributes["definition_name"] and calls Definitions.get_active_by_name/2 in the tenant; no 8D child definition exists anywhere in test/fixtures/qa or scripts/seed_vortex_definition.sh; scenario EO-002 expects a task referencing definition proc-vortex-8d-corrective-action assigned to role-procurement-manager; scripts/seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh deliberately does not seed role-procurement-manager (comment + a refute in test/scripts/persona_actor_seed_drift_test.exs, plus mutation test M2 and count 4 / M1-M8) -- those will need to flip; actor-vortex-felix is the procurement_manager persona (currently role-less). Also verify: child variable inheritance and output merge (interface optional?), how a child HUMAN_TASK is completed (which instance id / task endpoint scenario step 3 hits), that a child graph START->HUMAN_TASK->END is valid per graph.ex, and that the remaining steps (close-deviation SERVICE_TASK -> end-closed) then complete. Also check test/fixtures/simulation/vortex/*, test/fixtures/uat/process-definition-aliases/*, scripts/uat_preflight.sh and scripts/README.md. Fix is FIXTURE/SEED side only (no lib/ change unless proven unavoidable -- if so say so loudly).

result.summary:
REGISTRY (Step 0.5): docs/issues/ has no resolved entry for this symptom. Related: ISS-0931 (persona/role seeding; deliberately left role-procurement-manager unseeded because no definition referenced it -- that premise changes with this fix), ISS-0897/0930 (vortex definition seeding / service-task endpoints), ISS-0932 (Q-915, resolved, fixture-only precedent). Not a recurrence. ISS-0929.yaml created (status open, Q-929, GH-2115, MAJOR).

REPRODUCTION: NOT dynamically reproduced. The worktree has no deps/_build and the only local Postgres containers belong to sibling sessions, so a mix run was not attempted; every claim below is from reading the shipped code and fixtures. The ELIXIR/TEST step must prove it with a fail-first test.

ROOT CAUSE (ORCH findings verified). (1) test/fixtures/qa/vortex_supplier_quality_deviation_process_definition.json (v1.1) declares corrective-action-subprocess as {id, node_type: SUB_PROCESS} with NO attributes. lib/letflow/engine/sub_process.ex resolve_child_definition/2 (~line 351-363) does get_in(attributes, ["definition_name"]); absent -> {:error, {:definition_not_found, {:missing_definition_name_attribute, node_id}}}, which Engine.complete_task routes (prepare_sub_process_children_for_completion, lib/letflow/engine.ex ~3934-3985) through SubProcess.to_error_args -> ExecutionError, code SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND (sub_process.ex ~251). That is exactly the UAT symptom after severity-classification completes with severity=critical. The fixture was ported from R-Co where the child was keyed differently (child_definition_id); no Letflow-side attribute was ever added. graph.ex has no validator for SUB_PROCESS definition_name (only CHK-18 interface), so the definition is accepted at create/activate time and fails only at runtime. (2) Even with the attribute set, definition_name resolves via Definitions.get_active_by_name/2 in the tenant, and NO 8D child definition exists: not in test/fixtures/qa (9 files: meridian x2, swiftroute, vortex production-order-release, vortex supplier-quality-deviation, vortex entity/records), not seeded by scripts/seed_vortex_definition.sh (only 'Production Order Release' and 'Supplier Quality Deviation'), and test/fixtures/simulation/vortex has no 8D definition either. process_work_order.yaml (the sim copy of the parent) also has the bare SUB_PROCESS node; it is NOT consumed by the REQ-207 test, which builds its own test-local graph and patches definition_name (test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs ~344-420, ~500-570). (3) EO-002 expects the child task on role-procurement-manager, but scripts/seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh (ROLES = 4 roles, PERSONAS felix = '') deliberately does not seed it (header comment lines 28-29), so felix could not claim/complete even a correctly spawned child task (Tasks router returns 403/409 assignee_role_not_held, lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex ~394, ~460).

ENGINE FACTS VERIFIED. Variables: with no `interface` attribute the child starts with a full copy of parent variables (build_child_initial_variables(nil, ..) sub_process.ex ~130) and on completion the child's full final variable map is merged back into the parent (build_parent_merge_variables(nil, ..) ~154), validated by the parent definition's registered variable schemas (build_completion_multi_from_merge ~800-840); interface is OPTIONAL, so no interface needed. Child graph START -> HUMAN_TASK -> END is valid: it is exactly @simple_child_graph in test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs ~412 (role-quality-manager there), which the passing REQ-207 test runs through Engine.complete_task and asserts parent COMPLETED. A START->END (synchronously completing) child must NOT be used: it collides on a Multi step (documented in that test, ~396-410). Child task completion: the child is its own instance (new instance_id, parent_instance_id set); its HUMAN_TASK is a normal task row on the child instance, so scenario step 3 is the ordinary POST /tasks/:task_id/complete by a caller holding role-procurement-manager, with the task found via GET /tasks (the actor's pending tasks, or ?instance_id=<child id>). The parent instance id is NOT the task's instance_id. Completing it cascades to the parent (SubProcess.append_completion_multi, sub_process.ex ~700-1000).

*** LOUD FINDING -- POSSIBLE lib/ BLOCKER (second defect, statically inferred, not yet dynamically proven) ***: after the child completes, the parent token advances from corrective-action-subprocess to close-deviation, which is a SERVICE_TASK. In SubProcess.build_completion_multi_from_merge (sub_process.ex ~865-905) the follow-on advance_until_stable result's pending events are DISCARDED (`{:ok, final_instance_state, _more_pending}`), and build_completion_write_steps (~950-1000) writes only TaskActivation (human tasks), token reconciliation, SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED event and the parent projection. grep confirms sub_process.ex contains NO service-task dispatch preparation (no prepare_service_task_dispatch / build_service_task_dispatch_multi, which Engine.create and the complete_task/timer-fire paths do call: engine.ex ~563-605, ~843-1260, ~2681). Expected consequence: the parent token parks at close-deviation (pending_service_task_nodes populated, but no service_task_dispatches row), the parent never reaches end-closed, and scenario EO-003 (COMPLETED, end-closed) would FAIL even after the fixture/seed fix. Existing sub-process tests only route child completion straight to END or to HUMAN_TASKs, so nothing covers SERVICE_TASK after SUB_PROCESS (same for TIMER). The fixture-only fix cannot cure this while close-deviation stays a SERVICE_TASK; changing close-deviation would diverge from the ported scenario/EO-003. The ELIXIR-DEV/TEST-DESIGNER step MUST first write the fail-first test (parent: ...SUB_PROCESS -> SERVICE_TASK -> END, child HUMAN_TASK; complete child task; assert a service_task_dispatches row exists and the parent is not stuck) and, if it fails, escalate to ORCH for a lib/ change (reuse prepare_service_task_dispatch + build_service_task_dispatch_multi for the post-merge pending events, and arm timers likewise). Note also the sibling follow-up Q-926 (SERVICE_TASK body_template not rendered) is unrelated to this.

NEEDED CHANGES (fixture/seed side, in order): (A) NEW child definition fixture, recommended file name test/fixtures/qa/vortex_8d_corrective_action_definition.json (deliberately NOT *_process_definition.json: test/letflow/scripts/qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test.exs globs qa/*_process_definition.json and TC-0930-01 requires >=1 SERVICE_TASK in every match, which a START->HUMAN_TASK->END child cannot satisfy; if the file is named *_process_definition.json instead, TC-0930-01 must be relaxed with a documented exemption). Content: name '8D Corrective Action', version '1.0', graph start(START) -> corrective-action-8d(HUMAN_TASK, attributes {role: role-procurement-manager}) -> end(END), edges e0/e1; no interface, no SERVICE_TASK. (B) Parent fixture test/fixtures/qa/vortex_supplier_quality_deviation_process_definition.json: bump version 1.1 -> 1.2 (re-seed rule is version-aware; 409 if same version) and give corrective-action-subprocess attributes {"definition_name": "8D Corrective Action"}; leave the rest unchanged. (C) scripts/seed_vortex_definition.sh: add a seed_definition call for '8D Corrective Action' (display name, URL-encoded '8D+Corrective+Action', new fixture path, alias 'proc-vortex-8d-corrective-action'), placed before the parent call (late-bound, order not required, but clearer); update the header (now three definitions, parent v1.2). (D) NEW alias sidecar test/fixtures/uat/process-definition-aliases/proc-vortex-8d-corrective-action.yaml copying the shape of proc-vortex-supplier-quality-deviation.yaml (process_id, definition_name '8D Corrective Action', company_id vortex, seed_script, fixture, issue_ref ISS-0929). scripts/uat_preflight.sh needs NO code change: it resolves only scenario `process_id` fields via the sidecar glob (lines ~239-262, ~594-616) and the 8D id appears only in EO-002 detail text; the sidecar is documentation/forward-compat. scripts/README.md line 13/15-27 describe the seed scripts generically; add one sentence if desired, no table row required. (E) scripts/seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh: add "role-procurement-manager" to ROLES (5) and change PERSONAS "actor-vortex-felix|" to "actor-vortex-felix|role-procurement-manager"; fix header ('4 roles' -> 5) and delete the 'deliberately NOT seeded' comment. (F) test/scripts/persona_actor_seed_drift_test.exs: add the new child fixture path to @tenants["vortex"].fixtures (the role set is derived from fixture HUMAN_TASK roles via collect_roles/2), count 4 -> 5 here and in M2/M6 call sites that pass 4; remove the `refute ... role-procurement-manager must not be seeded` assertion (~lines 163-164); rewrite mutation M2 (currently 'adding role-procurement-manager to vortex ROLES is detected', now a legitimate role) to the inverse -- dropping role-procurement-manager from vortex ROLES must be detected with msg =~ missing_in_script=["role-procurement-manager"]; check M3-M8 still hold with the new count. (G) test/letflow/scripts/ new fixture contract test (parent SUB_PROCESS node has non-empty definition_name that equals the child fixture's name; child graph passes Graph validation; child has exactly one HUMAN_TASK on role-procurement-manager; seed script references the child fixture) plus the engine-level fail-first test above. (H) Optional/nice-to-have: mirror definition_name in test/fixtures/simulation/vortex/process_work_order.yaml (REQ-207 test does not read the node attributes from it, so it is safe either way); ISS-0931 design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0931-meridian-vortex-persona-actor-provisioning.md mentions procurement as unseeded -- update the sentence. (I) Ops note for ORCH/UAT: QA needs a re-seed (seed_vortex_definition.sh then seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh, in that order) before the scenario can pass; the persona script requires definitions seeded first for role discovery context per its header.

RISKS: (1) the lib/ SERVICE_TASK-after-SUB_PROCESS defect above (highest; may force a lib/ change and the SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER gates); (2) drift test counts/mutations are brittle -- all `4` literals tied to vortex must be found; (3) version bump to 1.2 means a QA ACTIVE v1.1 definition is deprecated on re-seed, in-flight v1.1 instances keep their snapshot; (4) variable-schema validation on output merge: the child's output vars (corrective_action_result, resolution_status) merge into the parent and are checked against registered schemas -- none are known for the vortex tenant, but the fix step should confirm unregistered keys pass (VariableSchema.variable_validations, REQ-109); (5) UAT discoverability: the child task is on a different instance_id than the one the scenario captured, so UAT-RUNNER must look it up by role (GET /tasks as felix) rather than by parent instance id; EO-002 'task_assigned' check may need the runner to search the child; (6) naming choice 'definition_ref proc-vortex-8d-corrective-action' in EO-002 is a scenario-corpus id, not an app key (same situation as ISS-0897's aliases).

NO lib/ OR AUTHZ CHANGE is required for the ERROR symptom itself (SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND) -- fixture/seed only. A lib/ change is likely required ONLY for the second, statically-inferred defect (SERVICE_TASK after SUB_PROCESS); that must be confirmed by a failing test before designing it.

HANDOFF LINT: `mix letflow.lint_handoffs` could not be run here (worktree has no deps/_build; compiling is out of scope). The file was shaped to mirror handoffs/WF03-Q915-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json key-for-key. Known H5 gap: handoffs/registry.json has no run entry for WF03-Q929-20261001 yet; ORCH owns registering it (registry write intentionally not done by this step).
